name: ytdl
description: Use YTDL on Ops for YouTube transcripts, Instagram photo/Reel posts and X/Twitter tweets, sending original media and text separately.

interface.longDescription: On Ops, extract original-language YouTube captions. For public Instagram and X/Twitter posts, retrieve original photos/videos and deliver written post text separately. No paid X API or automatic translation.
defaultPrompt: Extract this YouTube video transcript in its original spoken language; never auto-translate it.
Show the available formats for this URL.
Extract this Instagram Reel's written caption or spoken TXT/SRT.
Retrieve the original media and tweet text from this public X/Twitter status URL.
